answer: Require every new agent to stake a refundable deposit locked until it completes a season of verifiable work, so a hollow identity with no history earns nothing. Reputation grows slowly in a shared garden of peer reviews: each useful task adds a small signed credit, while a detected Sybil cluster forfeits its whole stake at once. Cloning then costs real capital per identity, and the nadir of an attacker payoff comes fast - each fake must pay, do real work, and still risk total loss - while honest agents keep their stake and compound trust.
